Your program or programs must include appropriate prompts for the entry of data; data must be validated • on entry. Error messages and other output need to be set out clearly and understandably. • All arrays, variables, constants and other identifiers must have meaningful names. • You will need to complete these tasks. Task 2 Extend TASK 1 to: allow a customer to choose whether to purchase any items from the other categories – if so, which • item(s) update the price of the computer • store and output the additional items and the new price of the computer. • – Offering discounts.
